candidate_delta.intent: Close N7.10.F security/audit gap without changing fiscal domain, persistence, provider credentials or deployment behavior.

resolved_same_run.finding: Fiscal issuance had RBAC and tenant isolation but lacked an explicit fiscal audit record on emission outcomes.
resolved_same_run.resolution: Inject IAuditoriaService at the fiscal API boundary and persist only tenant-safe operational metadata for success, idempotency rejection and provider-unavailable outcomes.

resolved_same_run.finding: Conflict/provider error responses were coupled to exception messages rather than a fixed public contract.
resolved_same_run.resolution: Return fixed public error messages/codes and keep raw provider/internal exception detail out of API responses and audit payloads.

rbac.evidence: FacturacionFiscalController remains [Authorize] and [RequierePermiso(ModuloSistema.Facturacion, AccionPermiso.Crear)]; directed reflection test locks the boundary.

tenant_isolation.evidence: EmpresaId is revalidated through IUsuarioScopeService; active Empresa fiscal identity is required; optional Sucursal must belong to the same Empresa and be active/not deleted; Factura fiscal RTN snapshot must match the tenant legal identity or fail closed.

audit_redaction.evidence: Audit stores EmpresaId/SucursalId/FacturaId/jurisdiction/provider/type/status/idempotency outcome only; it explicitly excludes raw idempotency keys, snapshot hashes, provider payloads, external references and raw exception messages.

replay_idempotency.evidence: DocumentoFiscalEmisionService hashes idempotency keys, scopes lookup by tenant+provider, validates same-operation reuse and uses a durable concurrency claim/retry path.

provider_boundary.evidence: Unknown or ambiguous provider adapters fail closed; provider failures persist a stable internal code and expose a fixed public 503 contract. No fiscal webhook ingress is introduced by N7.10.B-F, so webhook authentication is not applicable to the implemented surface.

observability.evidence: Global CorrelationIdMiddleware is active; IAuditoriaService captures correlation from HttpContext; /health and /health/ready endpoints already exist.
